publication.title: Breast cancer risk prediction using a clinical risk model and polygenic risk score.

samples.phenotyping_free: Cases were ascertained by linkage to the California Cancer Registry and defined as pathologically-confirmed diagnoses of invasive breast cancers with positive/elevated ER expression on immunohistochemical staining. ER-negative cases and those with unavailable ER status were excluded. Excluded women self-identified as premenopausal, perimenopausal, or postmenopausal as a direct result of surgery or medical treatments, such as chemotherapy. Women on hormonal therapy or selective estrogen receptor modulators at the time of blood draw were also excluded.

samples.cohorts_additional: Nested case-control study from the CPMC Breast Health Cohort.
